_note: Draft of src/data/wildlife-catalog/status-labels.json (spec 2.11), v3.3. Card labels and system names by Bob, 2026-10-08 (/workspace/nature-catalog-iucn-labels-2026-10-08.json and .md). Each label: { text, sourceUrl, needsNativeReview? }; each locale also has a primary sourceUrl and its source list. needsNativeReview: true = wording not verbatim in a source (checker WARN, not FAIL; a native speaker confirms before the first card that uses it ships). null = still a placeholder (scope phrases, OSPAR region phrase, NatureServe and US ESA value names: Bob's bonus value maps are only in the .md, not in the JSON, so they are not merged). Size-group labels live in the registry scaleLabels (copied here for reference). extinctionPeriod and noIucnBefore1500 implement Boss Bot ruling (a) part 2; their RU / PL / LV wording is Jimmy's and needs native review. REVIEW 2026-10-08 (Bob): corrected copy of Jimmy's v3.3 draft, see nature-catalog-status-labels-reviewed-2026-10-08.changelog.md. New optional Label key 'verified' (string, names the confirming source) needs one line in schema.mjs Label: verified: z.string().optional(). needsNativeReview kept true wherever only lv.wikipedia or Bob's judgement supports the wording; no native speaker has reviewed any of it.
